description.value: The Gabriola Island Branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has anchored island community life since 1999, when it opened inside the bustling Gabriola Folklife Village after replacing a bookmobile and a books-by-mail service. The branch has grown steadily in size and scope over the decades and offers free Wi-Fi alongside bookable meeting spaces. For touring cyclists arriving on the island by ferry, it serves as a convenient public landmark and rest stop in the heart of the village commercial area.
